data.title: 鸢一折纸 · 白色花园的精确誓约
data.description: 【AST 纪念花园·清晨】折纸换下作战装备，穿着线条利落的白色婚纱站在整齐的玫瑰拱门下；她先精准调整头纱角度，再把一朵白玫瑰别到胸前，冰蓝色眼神在看向镜头时罕见地显出柔软。
data.action: 玫瑰拱门下调整头纱并别上白玫瑰，转向镜头时露出罕见柔软微笑
data.lighting: cool morning light with silver dew highlights
data.mood: 克制表情里的温柔誓约
data.promptProse: Under the geometric rose arch, Origami Tobiichi checks her short veil's alignment and pins the final white rose to her tailored bridal gown. She turns toward the viewer with a rare small smile and softened blue eyes. The vertical medium-full view places arch uprights beside her and the morning garden beyond. Cool daylight defines the silver fastening and veil folds, while dew on the roses catches tiny bright highlights.
